_comment: Channel marker for the dev build target. Identity (applicationName, AppIds, dataFolderName, mutex names, updateUrl) is intentionally NOT overridden — a single unified installer serves all 3 channels and the user picks the channel at the login screen. The auto-updater then reads product.channels[<selected>].updateUrl. This file exists only so the build workflow can pass `dev` as the channel argument without erroring.
